name: Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB)
citation: Dal Pozzolo, A., Caelen, O., Johnson, R. A., & Bontempi, G. (2015). Calibrating probability with undersampling for unbalanced classification. IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence. Université Libre de Bruxelles, MLG.
notes: 284,807 transactions by European cardholders over two days in September 2013; 492 fraudulent (0.172%). V1..V28 are PCA components published in place of the original features for confidentiality.
